+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_masked_email(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    local, _, domain = user["email"].partition("@")
+    masked_local = local[:1] + "*" * (len(local) - 1)
+    return 200, {"masked": f"{masked_local}@{domain}"}

--- a/tests/test_masked_email.py
+++ b/tests/test_masked_email.py
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_masked_email
+
+
+def test_masked_email_ok():
+    assert handle_masked_email({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"masked": "a**@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_masked_email_other_user():
+    assert handle_masked_email({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"masked": "g****@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_masked_email_single_char_local_part(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "app.services.users.get_user",
+        lambda user_id: {"id": user_id, "name": "X", "email": "x@example.com"},
+    )
+    assert handle_masked_email({"id": "4"}) == (200, {"masked": "x@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_masked_email_missing_id():
+    assert handle_masked_email({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_masked_email_non_string_id():
+    assert handle_masked_email({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_masked_email_non_digit_id():
+    assert handle_masked_email({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_masked_email_not_found():
+    assert handle_masked_email({"id": "99"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
